meta.note: Classic-era (patch 1.12) dungeon quests. Names, quest levels, and links are from Wowhead Classic. Required levels, givers, chains, and item rewards use the same quest IDs from the 1.12.1 world database. They may differ in WoW: Forever.
gaps: Dungeon Set 2 (Tier 0.5, An Earnest Proposition) is not listed. It is a separate class-by-class chain that runs through several dungeons and is filed under city quest givers.
Enchanted Thorium Platemail Volumes I–III (quests 7649, 7650, 7651) drop from books with empty loot tables in the 1.12 export, so they are not placed in a dungeon.
Gnomeregan: the Sparklematic 5200 quests share one objective item name, so each quest id cannot be tied to a specific grime-encrusted item.
Dire Maul: class-book turn-ins are grouped together because the export does not record which boss drops each book. Quest 1318 has no giver in the export and is the same task as 7703.
Dire Maul Horde librams 7478, 7479, and 7480 have no Wowhead Classic tooltip. Names are the 1.12 titles. The Alliance librams are quests 7483, 7484, and 7485.
Scarlet Monastery has no quest that is only the Armory or only the Cathedral. Herod, Mograine, and Whitemane are objectives on the multi-wing quests.
Wailing Caverns has two Glowing Shard quests (3366 and 6981). Both exist on Wowhead Classic; 3366 has no quest level on the tooltip.
Wowhead Classic tooltips for a few item or script quests omit the quest level (373, 2279, 3366, 3375, 4765, 6981, 8733, and the Horde librams). Those levels are the 1.12 values.

Three Wowhead Classic titles differ from the 1.12 database: Pip Quickwit (5047, 1.12 Finkle Einhorn), The Great Ezra Grimm (5214, 1.12 Fras Siabi), and Nostro's Compendium (7507, 1.12 Foror). Both names are noted on the quest.
